subject: SIR and the list of the dead
alt: Cartoon: a lawyer in a black coat tells the blindfolded goddess of justice, who sits holding the scales: in the SIR, your name has gone into the list of dead people.
chutki: The goddess of justice was blindfolded so that she would not judge anyone by their face. Dhodapkar asks: if the goddess herself lands in the list of the dead, what use is the blindfold? The lawyer sahib in the black coat delivers the news as if it were an ordinary office notice.

The goddess is made of stone, perhaps that is why the people who made the list did not find her alive. But this is where the satire cuts: in a country where justice itself has to fill a form to prove it is alive, just imagine what happens to the common man's application.
